purpose: Frozen opponent pool for online self-play (todo 26 / A14). Members are LOCAL snapshots only; no heuristic opponents; no server protocol change (membership is expressed through per-worker configs + this file).

148,800-step checkpoint; also the [rl].anchor_state_file KL anchor since patch 0008 and the 1v3/pool-B champion. Kept as the stable reference member.

tag='random-baseline', saved 2026-08-10; weights-only export (config/mortal/current_dqn, no optimizer). The fork's historical frozen training opponent ([baseline.train]). Weakest member: a floor anchor, not a heuristic.

aliases.note: byte-identical duplicate; NOT a separate member (duplicates would double-sample the same weights).

DQN-only snapshot (keys model/optimizer/steps/timestamp; no 'mortal'/'current_dqn'); cannot be loaded as a Mortal opponent.
dataset file index, not a model.
dataset file index, not a model.

weighting.rule: recency-weighted; raw weight w_i = 2 ** (-rank_i / half_life_ranks), normalized over ACTIVE members so the stored probabilities sum to 1.0
weighting.rank_key: snapshot training steps descending; members without steps rank oldest (tie-break: file mtime)

sampling.algorithm: A CYCLE is a full rotation: repeatedly draw one member from the remaining set with probability w_i / sum(w_remaining), remove it, append; continue until every active member is drawn exactly once. Split the drawn sequence into consecutive waves of k workers. So every active member is assigned exactly once per cycle and each wave has k DISTINCT members.
sampling.worker_order: draw position index maps to worker index (position 0 -> worker 0, ...)

promotion.trigger: a new snapshot is frozen locally (e.g. copied to runs/exp/PINNED/mortal.pth.at-<steps>) and proposed as a member
procedure: 1. copy/pin the snapshot under a frozen path; record bytes + sha256 (no live path, no in-training file)
2. append to members with status=active, steps, mtime, provenance
3. re-rank ALL candidates with the same rank_key and recompute raw weights with the same formula

4. if active count > max_active, retire the lowest-weight member(s) until active <= max_active (status=retired, retired_at, retired_reason='displaced by <new-id> (max_active=4)'); the file is NOT deleted
5. recompute and store the explicit normalized weights over the remaining active members (sum must be 1)
6. sample the assign for the NEXT cycle (a cycle already running keeps its stored schedule); update cycle_length_waves = ceil(N_active/k)
promotion.retirement: retired members keep path/bytes/sha256 but get weight 0 and are skipped by the sampler; re-activation is an explicit status flip followed by re-rank/re-weight/re-sample of future cycles.
promotion.example: promoting a 250k-step snapshot makes ranks [new, best-220000, at-175200, at-148800, baseline]; new stored weights over the 4 survivors = {new: 0.533333, best-220000: 0.266667, at-175200: 0.133333, at-148800: 0.066667} and baseline is retired.

invariants: every ACTIVE member file must exist with the recorded bytes and sha256, otherwise prepare/launch refuse to start (no silent downgrade)
assign ids are active members; members within a wave are pairwise distinct; across a cycle each active member appears exactly once
pool members are local snapshots only; checkpoints/mortal.pth (live) is excluded by construction
a smoke covering one full cycle has every active member appearing in >= 1 completed session
